collocations.en: so far; up to this point

messages.en: How many sections have you finished so far?
I've only finished two sections so far. I'm going to work on the rest tonight.

senses.en_definition: After; once an action or event is complete.

messages.en: Message me when you've finished eating, okay? We'll head off together.
Okay, I'm still eating. I'll message you when I'm done.

senses.en_definition: Half; one of two equal parts of a whole.
Partly; incompletely or without fully reaching a particular state.

collocations.en: half-cooked; half-baked (of an idea or plan)

senses.en_definition: (Colloquial, derogatory) Considered mentally unsound or somewhat mad.

collocations.en: someone who's not quite right in the head
not quite right in the head

senses.en_definition: Some; a proportion of the people or things in a group.

messages.en: I've just left home. Can you wait another half an hour?
Sure. I'll hang out at the coffee shop in front of the station for now. Let me know when you get here.

senses.en_definition: Next; then, introducing the next action or point.
Further; continuing the treatment or consideration of something.
In the phrase dan seterusnya: and so on; continuing a list or sequence.

collocations.en: one, two, three, and so on

senses.en_definition: Next; immediately following in a sequence.
From then or now on; thereafter.

collocations.en: never dare to do so again after that

messages.en: Oh no, the bus just left. Are you here yet?
Yeah, I'm at the far end of the bus stop. Let's just wait for the next bus.
Okay, I'll come over. Hopefully we won't have to wait too long.
